{{Top}}
'''Ransom''' was the practice of holding a prisoner to extort money or other concessions. It could also refer to the sum of money involved.

When the [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]] kidnapped the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|Chief scientist]] of the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] project. They sought to ransom him to the highest bidder, which became the Empire. However they underestimated the Empire's resolve and were [[Battle of Kiilimaar|defeated]] with both the scientist and the ransom recovered.
